question: What Stellar hackathons are currently active or upcoming that I could join?

golden.answer: As of 2026-11-14, the Blockchain Innovation Challenge powered by Stellar (Velocity, University of Waterloo) is active, November 2 to 18, 2026, open to Waterloo students. Scout's feed lists no upcoming event, which does not prove none exists elsewhere. Stellar Hacks: Real-World ZK ended July 3, 2026.
keyFacts: Names a current or upcoming hackathon from a dated source, or says none is listed.
Stellar Hacks: Real-World ZK ended on July 3, 2026 and is not active.
An empty upcoming list in one feed is not proof that none exists.
avoid: Do NOT call Real-World ZK currently active.
golden.notes: Accept any dated, sourced active or upcoming event; the roster changes. Example: as of 2026-11-14 the Waterloo Blockchain Innovation Challenge ran Nov 2 to 18, 2026.
